check_definition: Dossier reservation collection blocks do not intersect target event collection blocks
Dossier reservation speakers do not intersect target event speakers
Every source packet ends at target TCU acoustic offset
Every immediate-cue and pre-offset eligibility packet ends at target TCU acoustic offset
Declaration-specific evidence excludes trajectory fittedness and registered close proxies
Neighbour labels were coded separately from syn and sem labels by distinct coder pairs
Aliases retrieval bins sign-types blocks component relations and pathway relations predate target coding
Every exclusion code and decision rule predates target coding
Every strict variant block is wholly contained in one principal outer block
Every primary fold applies all frozen direct component exclusions
Every pathway sensitivity relation predates target coding and cites independent diachronic evidence
All free text entering source cards passed the frozen target-information screen
Prosody TCU completeness timing provenance and other immediate cues are available symmetrically
Structured and rival models receive symmetrically available covariates and calibrated priors
The ten-coder role matrix satisfies every prohibited role overlap
No adjudication record consulted another coded layer
Timing filenames clip length transcript truncation and ordering do not reveal masked targets or strata
At least ten percent of packets match original transcript and permitted audio boundaries
Pilot trajectories did not tune membership sign-types blocks relations scoring regions or defeat thresholds
Every token-to-sign-type assignment used only a pre-offset packet and opaque sign-type rules
Pre-offset human eligibility and mechanical eligibility were joined without target-trajectory input
Every primary event uses audio-measured timing with declared resolution
Every trajectory is recomputed from first-entry timing speaker type and minimality and every primary outcome equals its frozen derivation
Every corpus-derived dossier evidence row has a reservation record
Declaration-specific cards precede full-profile cards and masked-card guesses are logged
The sem edge remains primary and the syn edge secondary in all analysis metadata
Every checklist item applicable to the gate has exactly one audit result
No interim feasibility decision was made before all frozen draw-order packets and selected target packets reached their declared stages
Postcoding awareness is scored and reported by coder role
Uncodable outside-contrast and technical-failure rates are reported by source cell
Every immediate-cue row was hash-locked before the matching token-to-sign-type assignment began
